pois.name: Mercado Ver-o-Peso
pois.intro: The Ver-o-Peso Market, Mercado Municipal Bolonha de Peixe, Mercado de Ferro, or Ver-o-Peso is a street market and fair, and small port area inaugurated in 1901 that is part of the Ver-o-Peso Complex. It is located in the city of Belém in the neighborhood of Campina, on the shores of Guajará Bay, next to the Docks Station.

pois.name: Mangal das Garças
pois.intro: O Mangal das Garças, inaugurado em 12 de janeiro de 2005, está localizado às margens do rio Guamá, em pleno centro histórico de Belém do Pará, no entorno do Arsenal da Marinha. O parque ecológico é resultado da revitalização de uma área de 40.000 m², uma síntese do ambiente amazônico no coração da capital paraense.

pois.name: Theatro da Paz
pois.intro: Theatro da Paz is a theater located in the Praça da República on the city of Belém, capital of the state of Pará, in Brazil. It was built following neoclassical architectural lines during the golden age of rubber in Amazon Basin.

pois.name: Casa do Saulo das Onze Janelas
Catedral Metropolitana de Belém
pois.intro: The Our Lady of Grace Cathedral also called Catedral Nossa Senhora de Belém. It is the seat of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Belém do Pará and is located in the old quarter of the city in Belém in Brazil.

pois.name: Basílica Santuário de Nossa Senhora de Nazaré
pois.address: 1300 Avenida Nossa Senhora de Nazaré, Belém, 66035-145
pois.wikipedia: pt:Basílica de Nossa Senhora de Nazaré
pois.intro: The Basilica of Our Lady of Nazareth of Exile is a minor basilica of the Catholic Church located in the city of Belém, Pará, Brazil. Its construction started in 1909 at the place where the image of the Virgin of Nazareth was found by Plácido José de Souza in the state of Pará, on the banks of the Murututu Igarapé.

pois.name: Parque Zoobotânico do Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi
pois.intro: The Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, commonly shortened MPEG, is a Brazilian research institution and museum located in the city of Belém, state of Pará, Brazil.

pois.name: Estação das Docas
pois.intro: The Estação das Docas is a Brazilian tourist-cultural complex and multi-environmental space created in 2000. It is located in the Campina neighborhood, in Belém, the capital of Pará, and was originally built as part of the city's port.

pois.name: Forte do Castelo
pois.intro: Forte do Presépio is a fort located in Belém, Pará, Brazil. It was built in 1616 by Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco at Maúri Point, a promontory on the right bank of the mouth of the Guamá River and Guajará Bay.

pois.name: Palácio das Docas
pois.intro: The Companhia Docas do Pará, commonly shortened CDP, is a company that manages the ports of the state of Pará. Founded in 1967, it has been a joint-stock company since 1969, with the Federal Government of Brazil as its majority shareholder.

pois.name: Museu Histórico do Estado do Pará
pois.intro: The Pará State Museum, officially the Pará State Historical Museum, or MHEP, is a Brazilian government institute created in 1981 and currently housed in the Lauro Sodré Palace, in the Cidade Velha district of Belém.

pois.name: Herbário Profª Drª Marlene Freitas da Silva (MFS)
pois.description: Herbário da Universidade do Estado do Pará com coleções científicas de plantas secas (exsicatas), flores, frutos e sementes, fungos, briófitas e biocultural (etnobotânica).
pois.intro: O Herbário Profª Drª Marlene Freitas da Silva da Universidade do Estado do Pará é um herbário universitário localizado na cidade de Belém. O herbário realiza a salvaguarda, pesquisa e comunicação de suas coleções, compostas por exsicatas, frutos e sementes, flores, plântulas, briófitas, fungos e uma coleção biocultural, prioritariamente da região Amazônica.

pois.name: Palácio Antônio Lemos
pois.intro: The Palácio Antônio Lemos, also called the Belém Art Museum, is a public building, palace, museum, and the city hall of Belém, built in 1860 by José da Gama Abreu, in the context of the rubber cycle. It is located in the Cidade Velha neighborhood.

pois.name: Igreja de Nossa Senhora das Mercês
pois.wikipedia: pt:Igreja de Nossa Senhora das Mercês (Belém)
pois.intro: A Igreja de Nossa Senhora das Mercês localiza-se na praça Visconde do Rio Branco, popularmente conhecida como Praça das Mercês, na cidade de Belém, no estado brasileiro do Pará. Ela é parte integrante do conjunto arquitetônico do Convento dos Mercedários.

pois.name: Palácio Lauro Sodré
pois.intro: Lauro Sodré Palace, also called Government Palace, and initially called Residence House, is a public building, palace, museum and seat of the state government, built in 1680 and located in the neighborhood of Cidade Velha, in the Brazilian city of Belém, in the state of Pará.

pois.name: Casa das Onze Janelas
pois.intro: The House of the Eleven Windows Cultural Space, initially called Palace of the Eleven Windows, is a complex composed of a public square and a historical building located in the Brazilian city of Belém, in Pará. Since 2002 in Brazil, the space houses a contemporary art museum, along with a restaurant and a multicultural area.

pois.name: Palacete Bolonha
pois.intro: The Bolonha Mansion is a historic residence in Belém, Pará, Brazil. It was built between 1905 and 1908 by the architect Francisco Bolonha as a gift to his wife Alice Tem-Brink; he is also noted as the father of the modernist architect Francisco de Paula Lemos Bolonha.

pois.name: Memorial de Navegação da Amazônia
pois.intro: O Memorial Amazônico da Navegação é um museu histórico brasileiro em Belém, Pará, inaugurado em 2005. Possui em seu acervo exposições e objetos que relembram a relação do homem da Amazônia com as águas, bem como a participação da Marinha do Brasil em eventos históricos no Pará.

pois.name: Museu de Arte Sacra do Pará
pois.wikipedia: pt:Igreja e Colégio de Santo Alexandre

pois.name: Igreja de São João Batista
pois.intro: The Church of Saint John the Baptist, also known as the Igreja de São Joãozinho, is a colonial temple located in Líbano Square, also known as Largo de São João, in the city of Belém, in the Brazilian state of Pará. Built in the Baroque style and designed by the Italian Giuseppe Antonio Landi, the small church has an irregular octagonal nave and a central dome.

pois.name: Palacete Pinho
pois.intro: Pinho Mansion is a historic building located at 586 Doutor Assis Street in the Cidade Velha district, in Belém, the capital of the state of Pará. In 1986, it was listed as a national heritage site by the National Institute of Historic and Artistic Heritage for its importance in the city.

pois.name: Solar da Beira
pois.intro: Solar da Beira is a public building designed in the neoclassical architectural style that integrates the Ver-o-Peso Complex. It is located in the Brazilian city of Belém, Pará, in the Cidade Velha neighborhood, on the shores of Guajará Bay.

pois.name: Igreja do Carmo
pois.wikipedia: pt:Igreja de Nossa Senhora do Carmo (Belém)
pois.intro: The Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel is a Catholic church located in the historic center of Belém. The current building dates back to the 18th century and was designed by several architects, including Antônio Landi.

pois.description: Somos uma loja de presentes e gifts, trabalhamos com personalização de canecas, copos, taças e outros personalizados. Põe Na Caneca, agregando valor à SUA marca!

pois.name: Feira do Açái
pois.intro: The Feira do Açaí is a public trading post, an open-air market for the commercialization of açaí, a small port area, and a set of bars, which is part of the Ver-o-Peso Complex, located on the shores of the Guajará Bay in the district of Cidade Velha, in the city of Belém, Pará, Brazil.

pois.name: Praça Siqueira Campos
pois.intro: The Siqueira Campos Square or Clock Square is a public space located at the Ver-o-Peso Dock, in the Cidade Velha neighborhood, in the Brazilian city of Belém, capital of Pará. The site, which is known for housing a huge English clock, comprises a total area of 2,727.45m², 1,246.78m² of paved area and 1,480.67m² of green area.

pois.name: Bosque Rodrigues Alves
pois.intro: The Rodrigues Alves Park and Botanical Garden of Amazonia, or simply Rodrigues Alves Park is a Brazilian environmental preservation area located in the Marco neighborhood, in the city of Belém, the capital of the state of Pará.

pois.name: Farol de Belém
pois.intro: Le phare de Belém est phare moderne situé dans le quartier de Ciudade Velha à Belém. Ce phare est la propriété de la Marine brésilienne et il est géré par le Centro de Sinalização Náutica e Reparos Almirante Moraes Rego au sein de la Direction de l'Hydrographie et de la Navigation.

pois.name: Praça Dom Frei Caetano Brandão
pois.intro: The Dom Frei Caetano Brandão Square, originally called Largo da Sé, is located in the Cidade Velha neighborhood in the Brazilian city of Belém, capital of the state of Pará. The square was the meeting point between colonists and indigenous people, as well as the initial mark of the colonization of Belém and the region.

pois.name: Ver-o-Rio
pois.intro: Ver-o-Rio is a tourist complex located in a 5,000-square-meter Brazilian public square inaugurated in 1999 in the city of Belém. It is on the shores of Guajará Bay in the Umarizal neighborhood and next to the Center of Social Sciences and Education of the State University of Pará.

pois.name: Colégio Estadual Paes de Carvalho
pois.intro: O Colégio Estadual Paes de Carvalho - CEPC é uma instituição pública de renome e respeito nacional, fundada em 28 de julho de 1841, localizada em Belém, no Pará.
